items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I started working with Freddie, Stanley Turrentine.

ctx.x: So you moved to New York.

Yeah, I moved to New York in ’61. I moved – actually, I’m next door to Bill. There was a bass player I had met in Detroit, named Vishnu Wood. His name was Bill Wood then. We worked with Yusef for a minute. I met him in Detroit. It turns out he had a place next door to Bill. I wound up staying with him and sharing the rent. He was hardly ever there. It was great. It was a great block to live in. Across the street were a bunch of guys, another bunch of guys from Philly: Reggie Workman, Tootie Heath, Spanky DeBrest.…
So you’re working. Are you working at this point? It’s your first gig.
